source_text: FGM, as classified by the World Health Organization into types I (clitoridectomy), II (excision of clitoris and labia), and III (infibulation, involving narrowing of the vaginal opening), often removes or damages the clitoris and surrounding nerve-rich tissue, leading to permanent loss of sexual sensation and pleasure in a majority of cases. [35]
